title: 2D Coordinate Person Placement Test
subtitle: Upload a scene image and a person image, let an LLM read the gridded floor plan into person/camera coordinates and camera direction, then send the camera-marked plan plus person reference to an image model.
targetHint: The target coordinate is written into the final prompt: X={x} means column {x} from left to right, Y={y} means row {y} from top to bottom, so the model receives coordinate ({x}, {y}).
promptPlaceholder: Example: The person enters from the door; place the camera inside the room looking toward the door, with the person slightly left of the doorway.
emptyUserPrompt: No extra user prompt has been entered yet.
emptyPreview: Upload a scene image to build the coordinate reference.
emptyFloorPlan: Upload a scene image and click Generate 2D and three views. The 2D floor plan is used for coordinate grids and camera markers.
emptyThreeView: The three-view sheet is sent as an additional reference to the final image model.
emptyCameraPreview: After the LLM returns coordinates, the camera icon and facing arrow are rendered on the ungridded floor plan.
emptyCharacter: Upload a person image to preview it here.
emptyResult: The model output appears here after a test run.
analysisJsonPlaceholder: Click Analyze coordinates to show the LLM output, or paste JSON manually.
analysisJsonInvalid: The JSON shape is invalid. It must include person, camera, cameraFacing, and shotIntent.
analysisRequiredForImagePrompt: A valid coordinate analysis JSON is required before previewing the final image prompt.

promptVariantDescriptions.camera_ray_cast: Treat the 2D image as an architectural plan and raycast from the camera cell along the arrow.
promptVariantDescriptions.reconstruct_3d: Reconstruct the 3D scene from the 2D layout and three-view sheet before rendering.
promptVariantDescriptions.director_blocking: Use the coordinates as film blocking: person position, camera position, and lens direction.
promptVariantDescriptions.strict_not_map: Strongly forbids top-down maps or floor plans and requires a ground/eye-level perspective.
